picks.title: NVIDIA brings agentic AI into Adobe, Blender and Unreal at SIGGRAPH 2026
picks.excerpt: At SIGGRAPH 2026 NVIDIA rolled out agentic AI for creative pros, with Model Context Protocol integrations that let AI assistants act inside Adobe, Blender, Unreal Engine and other design apps — inspecting scenes, flagging color issues and preparing export variants while artists keep creative control.
picks.rationale: Major SIGGRAPH release from a top-tier source that puts AI agents directly inside the apps designers use daily — high actionability and credibility.

picks.title: I watched Lightcraft turn a screenplay into a virtual film set using an iPhone
picks.excerpt: Hands-on with Lightcraft's Spark Story, unveiled at SIGGRAPH 2026: a screenplay-first virtual production tool that lets writers, directors and cinematographers build and shoot a virtual film set — recording shots with just an iPhone — long before any physical location or set exists.
picks.rationale: Fresh SIGGRAPH product unveiling with a genuinely new screenplay-to-set workflow shot from a phone — hands-on verified and distinct from the earlier Lightcraft vision interview.

picks.title: 'inversphere' folds entire 360-degree worlds into one sphere with 3DGS
picks.excerpt: A developer called VoxelKei released 'inversphere,' a technique that folds entire 360-degree environments into a single sphere for displaying 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes — a novel capture-and-display approach feeding real-time 3D and render workflows.
picks.rationale: A novel just-released 3DGS display technique — distinct from published 3DGS-generation tool releases — with a distinct accent from the other render pick.

picks.title: I stopped making my AI image prompts longer — style references helped more
picks.excerpt: Argues that piling more words into AI image prompts yields diminishing returns, and that supplying visual style references gives designers far more reliable, repeatable control over generated output — a practical shift in creative-AI craft.
picks.rationale: Practical craft shift that immediately changes how designers get repeatable results from image models — distinct accent from the other workflow pick.
